title: Fix ClassesPanel VFS-to-doc sync data loss: edits lost on publish/test/unmount before 600ms debounce + no re-hydrate on doc change
description:
Cross-feature integration audit found data-loss bugs at the ClassesPanel VFS<->doc.asClasses sync seam (packages/authoring-ui/src/ClassesPanel.tsx). The .fla persistence + Live Preview + autosave all compile/serialize from doc.asClasses, but ClassesPanel writes edits to the VFS immediately and only reconciles into doc.asClasses on a 600ms debounce — so edits are lost if anything reads the doc first. FIX ALL THREE: (1) HIGH/DATA-LOSS: a class edit then Test Movie / Publish / Live-Preview-recompile before the 600ms debounce fires compiles stale doc.asClasses and loses the edit (ClassesPanel.tsx ~179-191 handleScriptChange debounce; useExportHandlers.ts ~229 testMovie; usePublish.ts ~133-162 compileDocToBytes have no pre-flush). Make doc.asClasses reflect class edits reliably before any compile/save — preferred: update doc.asClasses synchronously/promptly on edit (keep a light debounce for history/pushDoc if needed for perf, but ensure publish/preview/save always see the latest edit), OR expose a flush and call it before compile. Simplest robust approach is to treat doc.asClasses as the source of truth and sync edits into it immediately (VFS is the editor surface). (2) MEDIUM/DATA-LOSS: on ClassesPanel UNMOUNT (closing the Classes tab) with a pending debounced sync, flush it (sync immediately) so the edit isn't dropped (ClassesPanel.tsx ~171-176 cleanup only clears the timer). (3) MEDIUM: VFS hydration effect is keyed on flaPath only (~129), so a project restore that changes doc.asClasses after mount leaves the panel showing stale classes — re-hydrate when the doc/asClasses identity changes (add to deps, guarded against clobbering an in-progress edit) or defer mount until restore. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable). Add regression tests: (a) edit a class then immediately compile/publish -> the compiled doc.asClasses includes the edit (no 600ms wait); (b) edit then unmount -> doc.asClasses has the edit; (c) doc.asClasses changing after mount re-hydrates the panel/VFS. Don't regress existing ClassesPanel tests. Update docs/33-as2-classes-vfs.md (sync semantics). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: ClassesPanel.tsx (+ maybe a tiny pre-compile flush hook) + tests.

=== QA ROOT-CAUSE AUGMENTATION (autonomous QA, HEAD 3410532) ===

CONFIRMED the worker's debounce/timing data-loss (scenarios c/d) AND root-caused a DISTINCT, SEPARATE data-loss bug (scenario a) that the original 1300 VFS QA flagged-but-DISMISSED as 'hardening note only' — that dismissal was WRONG (same flag-then-dismiss pattern as the 1316 Save-As race). BOTH must be fixed.

--- BUG A (NEW root cause, path-normalization mismatch in the CORE sync fn) ---
File: packages/core/src/vfs/sync.ts, syncDocFromVfs, line 99:
    const existing = (next.asClasses ?? []).find((c) => c.path === path);
and packages/core/src/model/document-mutations.ts addAsClass line 227:
    const idx = existing.findIndex((c) => c.path === file.path);
Both match RAW c.path (===) against a NORMALIZED `path` (sync.ts line 94 does normalizeClassPath(entry.path)). The REMOVAL pass in the same fn (lines 107-119) correctly normalizes BOTH sides; the add/match pass does NOT. hydrateVfsFromDoc (sync.ts line 57) writes NORMALIZED paths into the VFS, but doc.asClasses[].path is stored RAW — and nothing normalizes it on the way in: loadFla (packages/core/src/fla/zip.ts line 217) takes `path: k.slice(CLASSES_PREFIX.length)` straight from the zip entry key un-normalized; addAsClass stores the path as-given.
TRIGGER (real flows, not synthetic): any doc whose stored asClasses path is not already normalized — a `classes/<path>` zip entry key with a leading `./` or a `//`/backslash form (external tooling, hand-edited .fla, Windows path), or a real-FLA import. Then VFS-path (normalized) != doc-path (raw) so:
  * the no-change short-circuit `existing.source === source` (line 100) never fires -> EVERY sync re-adds;
  * addAsClass cannot find the existing entry -> APPENDS a DUPLICATE (normalized) entry instead of replacing;
  * the removal pass KEEPS the stale raw-path entry (its normalized form IS in vfsPaths).
RESULT: doc.asClasses ends up with TWO entries for one logical class — a STALE source and the edited source. runClassPass (packages/swf/src/compiler/classes.ts lines 163-190) compiles EVERY entry to its own DoInitAction, so the published SWF emits the class definition twice (the stale def can shadow/conflict; and the embed/.fla persists the stale duplicate forever; subsequent syncs keep re-appending).
FIX DIRECTION (Bug A): normalize BOTH sides of the match in syncDocFromVfs line 99 (compare normalizeClassPath(c.path) === path) AND in addAsClass line 227 (or normalize file.path on entry so all stored paths are canonical). Belt-and-braces: normalize the path in loadFla zip.ts line 217 so stored paths are always canonical. A one-shot de-dup/normalize migration of existing doc.asClasses on load is advisable.

--- BUG C/D (CONFIRMS worker's debounce loss) ---
syncDocFromVfs is invoked from EXACTLY ONE place: the debounced syncToDoc inside ClassesPanel.tsx (handleScriptChange line 186-188, EDIT_SYNC_DELAY_MS=600). grep confirms NO other caller (publish/test/save/autosave never call it). usePublish(doc) (Shell.tsx line 2618), testMovie, Live Preview, and the 1310 autosave (useProjectActions/documentStore, Shell.tsx ~2609) all read doc.asClasses directly from the store, which only receives the edit via the debounced pushDoc 600ms later. So a Test Movie / Publish / Live-Preview recompile / autosave snapshot / tab-close (unmount cleanup line 172-176 only clears the timer, no flush) within 600ms of a keystroke compiles/persists STALE class source. Scenario (d) autosave is the worst: it can persist a project .fla whose class source is stale, surviving F5.

--- PROOF (deterministic unit test, ALL PASS at HEAD 3410532) ---
packages/core/src/vfs/__tests__/sync-normalize-proof.test.ts (3 tests, green):
  1. PROOF: rawPath './com/example/Foo.as' -> after hydrate+edit+sync, doc.asClasses has 2 entries for Foo (stale v1 + edited v2) -> stale source leaks into the compiled/saved doc.
  2. CONTROL: an already-normalized path updates in place (1 entry) — proving the bug is specifically the normalization mismatch.
  3. PROOF: backslash path 'com\\example\\Win.as' with NO edit at all still re-adds + duplicates (no-change short-circuit dead) — proves churn even absent an edit.
NOTE: this proof test is left in the tree for the fixer as the Bug-A regression gate; after the fix, the 2-entry assertions should become 1-entry (the commented expected-post-fix assertions in test 1 document this).

--- ACCEPTANCE ADDITIONS for this task ---
(A) syncDocFromVfs + addAsClass match on NORMALIZED paths; a non-normalized stored path UPDATES in place (no duplicate) — use sync-normalize-proof.test.ts (flip its expectations to the post-fix 1-entry form).
(C/D) ensure publish/testMovie/Live-Preview/autosave see the latest class edit (flush-before-compile or sync-into-doc-immediately, per the worker's preferred approach).
